opening.speech: You have come from the water. I can smell it on you.

choices.text: Ilse says the abbey bell has stopped.

bell.speech: It stopped because the water is over the spit and has not gone back. I have been up on the rise three times to look, and three times it was still there. Whatever the abbey was keeping, the sea has it now.

people.speech: Walking inland, most of them, on the road you came by. You will meet them coming the other way before the day is out.

shrine.speech: For the ones the sea kept. It is a long list and it has just got longer.
